t: This is Holy Trinity Church on Beechwood Road in Dalston, a Church of England parish church that is also known as the Clowns' Church. It belongs to the parish of Holy Trinity with St Philip Dalston and All Saints, Haggerston. The architect was Ewan Christian, a leading Victorian who was Architect to the Ecclesiastical Commissioners for more than forty years. He is best known for restoring Southwell Minster and Carlisle Cathedral and for designing the National Portrait Gallery. He later served as president of the Royal Institute of British Architects.
